etsy.title: Large Print Word Search for Seniors, 25 Easy Puzzles Printable PDF, Big Letters, No Backwards Words, Answers Included, Gift for Grandma
etsy.description:
Big, clear letters and gentle puzzles that are a pleasure to solve. 🔎

25 themed word searches (garden, seaside, baking, birds, old-time music and more) on a 13 × 13 grid with extra-large letters. Words only go across, down or diagonally down, never backwards, so they are relaxing rather than frustrating.

WHAT'S INSIDE (34 pages)
• How to play page
• 25 large print puzzles, 12 words each, one per page
• Answer pages with highlighted solutions

Great for grandparents, care homes, waiting rooms and quiet afternoons.

INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped.
You get 2 PDFs: US Letter and A4. Print at home or at a print shop. For personal use only.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
